title: Fray Bentos mill north stepped hall
visualBrief: Whole independently placed north stepped hall roofed body inside Planta UPM Fray Bentos: full original 14-corner footprint, closed industrial walls and roof, base, estimated service entrances, upper louver bays and modest exposed trim. Separate process plant, chimney, tanks, conveyors, roads and yards remain separate; no whole-factory proxy. Already cleared U.S. Embassy Montevideo original photographs supply factory-level industrial material vocabulary only: light metal/concrete cladding, gray structural trim and dark louvers. They do not identify this specific hall or its roof profile, opening census, doors or attached machinery. Numerical original footprint and2022 relative-height observations govern a nominal2023 preview; temporal continuity to2023 is unverified; no source satellite photographs, orthophotos, map images, figures or owner report imagery used. Qualla-first 26 families already screened; no rights revalidation or new imagery adopted. Automated footprint has at least10m horizontal uncertainty; nominal height has at least5m uncertainty. Height observations are2022 data, not a2023survey; exact temporal continuity unverified. Whole original 14-corner numerical roof, all exterior walls/closed roof/base retained. Learned relative-height median22m from44 of66 passing original observations, range20.5–24m, interquartile21.5–22.5m. Original height-source year2022 supplies a nominal2023preview only; temporal continuity unverified. Automated footprint confidence rank0.6598, not a probability or surveyed classification. Effective4m resolution, at least5m height/10m horizontal uncertainty; no survey or floor census. Large relative-height spread and sparse passing observations supply only a bounded nominal whole-body height. No artificial roof steps or process machinery inferred from the learned gradient. Specific process identity, wall enclosure and original roof profile are not photographically established. Restrained horizontal girts are estimated panel support rhythm. Original conservative industrial details: low dual-pitch standing-seam roof, light-gray corrugated metal over low concrete base, plain gray trim/gutters/downpipes, two closed service/personnel entries and4 upper louver bays. Roof pitch, opening census, facade positions/materials/finish, function and precise2023condition unverified;3m component uncertainty. Opening heights scaled below the low eaves. Three already-cleared U.S.Embassy public-domain staff photographs supply factory material context only, not verified views of this specific hall; no process machinery transplanted. Field/frame/floor/main sections remain unmasked, unflattened and unfitted; exact contact and threshold vertical tie approximate. New full original polygon has no numerical overlap with the current authored mill bodies. All native reentrant corners remain open outside the roofed outline; no box fill across the notches. Four authored LODs retain all original corners and the complete body/roof/base/two closed entries/louver cues. Near levels restore physical recesses/blades/frames.
